# @moonloch/dcc-core-lib

> Pure-function TypeScript library for Dungeon Crawl Classics RPG game logic: dice chain, checks and saves, skills, spells, combat, character creation and advancement, cleric, patron, occupation and adventure helpers. No platform dependencies. Contains no official rulebook data; callers register their own licensed data.

The public surface is the set of exports from `src/index.ts`. The most precise, complete description is the generated declaration file: `dist/dcc-core-lib.d.ts` (one file, produced by `pnpm run build`). The generated markdown under `docs/api/` carries the same signatures and doc comments, one page per module.

## Reference

- [API index](docs/api/index.md): generated per-module API reference
- [Supplying game data](docs/DATA.md): file formats, schemas and registration functions for class progressions, tables, augurs, occupations, spells, patrons; copyright stance; minimal example
- [Modifier design](docs/MODIFIERS.md): the RollModifier type, application order and migration status
- [Event system](docs/EVENTS.md): callback-injection event interfaces
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): goals, module layout, data-loading and copyright policy

## Contributing
